prompt: Janet is editing the BIND zone file for "techcorp.net" to add a host named "printer" with IP 192.168.1.10. Which entries correctly add this host to the zone file and its corresponding reverse zone?
choices: printer IN PTR 192.168.1.10 in the zone file; 10.1.168.192.in-addr.arpa. IN A printer.techcorp.net. in the reverse zone
printer IN A 192.168.1.10 in the zone file; 10.1.168.192.in-addr.arpa. IN PTR printer.techcorp.net. in the reverse zone
printer IN CNAME 192.168.1.10 in the zone file; printer.techcorp.net. IN PTR 10.1.168.192 in the reverse zone
192.168.1.10 IN A printer in the zone file; printer IN PTR 10.1.168.192.in-addr.arpa. in the reverse zone
explanation: The forward zone needs an A record (printer IN A 192.168.1.10) and the reverse zone needs a PTR record (10.1.168.192.in-addr.arpa. IN PTR printer.techcorp.net.).
